Describe the concrete behavior change and requirement IDs.

Validation:

- Exact Make commands, host/tool versions, simulation mode and elapsed time.
- Retained result directory, source digest and report links.
- Requested and actually executed fuzz/fault budgets; replay/minimization command.
- Directed/full-RTL vectors and non-instrumented timing checks that executed.
- Failures and diagnosis, unrun checks and known requirement/platform gaps.

Keep lint, component synthesis, formal, CDC/RDC, four-state/reset and physical
qualification conclusions separate. Do not equate source coverage with acceptance.
